title: Fall of the Berlin Wall

slides.text: the night the berlin wall opened by mistake.
slides.image_query: Berlin Wall November 1989 crowd Brandenburg Gate

slides.text: in 1961, east germany built a wall around west berlin to stop its own people leaving. it ran for about 155 km.
on 9 november 1989, the government planned to ease travel rules. spokesman günter schabowski was handed the note just before a live press conference.
asked when the rules started, he checked the note and said: “immediately, without delay.” they were meant to start the next day.
thousands went straight to the border. at 11:30pm, with no orders, guard harald jäger opened the gate at bornholmer straße.
less than a year later, on 3 october 1990, east and west germany became one country again.

caption: the new travel rules were due to start on 10 november. one answer at a press conference moved them forward, and ended 28 years of the wall. 9 november 1989.
